integrity: Analytical proof, precise Gamma-tail estimates, explicit clock-control argument, and an independently executable finite consistency checker are included; finite tests do not certify infinite asymptotics.
scientific_limitations: Two equally sized preassigned classes, consecutive quotas, uniformly sampled independent draws, and divergent quota; no finite-size error bound, unbalanced-group result, or historical priority certification. The lowest-ratio joint law has an escaping coordinate.
title: Two-grade coupon completion: a universal Gumbel window and a sharp last-bottleneck crossover
